caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a man standing upright on a square decorative base. The man is dressed in a green buttoned jacket, white pants, black boots, red gloves, and a red cap. He is holding a circular object, possibly a horseshoe or a ring, in his right hand which is raised to chest level, while his left hand rests on his hip. His facial features and hands are dark brown, and the statue has a metallic sheen. The base is embellished with sculptural detailing along its upper edge. The background is a plain off-white color, and there are no additional objects or elements present in the composition. The artist’s name, R.M.A. Taylor, is written in small letters at the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Hitching Post
